user.title: Anytime Fitness group lessons
user.description:
Where does the group class schedule image come from?

- **Website**: the image behind "Bekijk het rooster" on the club site.
- **Media folder**: you upload the image yourself in Media → My media → {folder}. Use this when the club website blocks Home Assistant.

The image is read with an AI Task entity that can read images (for example Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama with a vision model) and becomes the calendar "Anytime Fitness group lessons". It is checked daily and only read again when it changed.

data_description.url: Only for the website source: the page with the "Bekijk het rooster" button, e.g. {example_url}.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Must be able to read images. Leave empty to use the default AI Task entity from Settings → System → General.

site_blocked.title: Club website blocks Home Assistant
site_blocked.description:
{url} refused the request from Home Assistant (HTTP 403, bot protection). The calendar keeps showing the last schedule it read.

Switch to the media folder: open this integration → ⋮ → **Reconfigure** → source **Media folder**. Then upload the schedule image in **Media → My media → Anytime Fitness**. The calendar and its history stay.

refresh.description: Check the club website for a new schedule image now. The image is only read again when it changed, unless you force it.

force.description: Read the image with AI even when it did not change.
